Redoes the push/196 rejections as targeted fixes that keep the original text's length and voice (the director's accepted descriptions go back in American spelling, with the original battle line corrected only where it was wrong), plus American-spelling fixes to 12 applied texts. Each item sends only the fields that change, with injectableInBattle at its live value (law 20). Every record's live text was confirmed unchanged in the push/201-202 capture before building; any that drifted were left out. Not resubmitted: totems, custom reskins, custom contributions, test and non-functioning jutsu, and texts the director called sufficient. Operator runs it from Forge; never skipPreflight.

The gust slashes through %target’s senses, disrupting their mental clarity and unraveling their resistance to harm. The eerie presence lingers, amplifying every attack to come.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; the vulnerability covers all damage rather than only genjutsu, and the caster is named with %user. Description from round 1.

data.description: The user flings a spiraling barrage of crescent wind scythes that cut through every enemy in their path. The rhythm of the assault sharpens the user's own edge, making their attacks hit harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user whirls in a blur of motion, launching a barrage of crescent-shaped wind scythes across the battlefield. As the scythes fly, chakra surges through their body, sharpening their offensive edge and enhancing the power of future attacks.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes the movement it does not have. Description from round 1, in American spelling.

data.description: The user conjures wraiths from the abyss that swarm through the target's mind. Their haunting shapes rake at every sense the target has, landing a sharp blow of mental damage.

suggestion.rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean; left unchanged. Description from round 1.

data.description: The user packs air into a dense orb between their palms and bursts it at the target, punching straight through their defenses. The shock leaves them reeling, so attacks against them hit a little harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user compresses air with precise chakra control into a tightly packed orb between their palms. With a sharp thrust, the orb explodes forward, releasing a concentrated shockwave that tears through the air. The blast distorts the surroundings as it barrels toward %target, hitting with the crushing force of pure atmospheric pressure.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; uses %target for the single target. Description from round 1, in American spelling.

data.description: The user traps the target in a mirage of shifting sand that crushes in around them. The phantom dunes may also mire their feet, leaving them unable to move for a short while.
data.battleDescription: With a subtle hand seal and a steady gaze, %user casts an illusion that traps %target in a mirage of shifting sands and scorching sun. In the false desert, every step becomes a struggle, and escape seems impossible. %target is struck by searing mirages while their movement is locked in the grip of the genjutsu’s disorienting landscape.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; swaps the generic 'the shinobi', 'the enemy' and 'The target' for %user and %target on a single-target jutsu. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user thrusts a palm forward and a wall of solid force rises between them and the target. Blows land softer on the user, and the target's own attacks lose some of their bite for a short time.
data.battleDescription: With a grounded stance, %user channels earth chakra into their palm before thrusting forward. A sudden wave of solid force erupts, intercepting %target’s attack and dispersing its power. This technique reduces the damage %user receives while subtly shifting the incoming force, blunting the strength of %target’s attacks with controlled redirection.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes the claim that it displaces the enemy (no movement effect) and names %target, whose attacks it weakens. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user plants their weight and drives an earth-charged kick upward into the target. The ground cracks beneath their heel as the blow lands with crushing force.
data.battleDescription: %user drops low and plants their weight before delivering a crushing upward kick infused with earth chakra. The ground beneath their foot cracks as force surges through the strike, slamming into %target with seismic impact. The blow drives deep into their body, the earth chakra hammering home with the weight of the land itself.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the opening and the cracking-ground image; removes the charge forward and the knockback across the battlefield, which the jutsu does not do (damage only), and names %target. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user drives lightning chakra into the earth, and a tiger of crackling electricity bursts out to maul the target. Its claws leave their body jolted and exposed, so attacks against them hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their palm into the earth, channeling lightning chakra through the terrain. From the surge, a roaring tiger made entirely of crackling electricity erupts into view, its body outlined in streaks of blinding light. The beast charges %target with terrifying speed, pouncing and delivering a mauling strike of raw elemental force. This genin-level jutsu strikes fear into opponents through its fierce visual and devastating impact.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; swaps 'The user' and 'the enemy' for %user and %target. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user floods the target's mind with the illusion of a violent surge of lightning. The shock feels real enough that it stuns them, stealing time from their next moves.

suggestion.rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user flashes across the field and lands in a storm of lightning-charged kicks. Every enemy around the landing spot is caught in the crackling flurry.
data.battleDescription: %user explodes forward in a storm of lightning-charged kicks, each strike cracking with blinding speed and power. The final roundhouse erupts in a flash of electricity, scattering a haze of sparks across the ground where %user lands.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; the last clause used %target and a stagger-back on an empty-ground area jutsu, now it describes the burst around the landing spot. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user calls up an infernal blaze from within, their aura roaring into flame. Every fire technique they unleash burns far fiercer for a short time.

suggestion.rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: Enshrouded in crackling energy, the user dons a mantle of lightning, amplifying the ferocity of their electric attacks until every strike sings with thunder’s fury.
data.battleDescription: %user surrounds their body in a radiant sheath of crackling lightning, each muscle fiber twitching with raw power. As they move, arcs of electricity trail behind them, lending raw force to every motion. Their strikes become charged with electric energy, enhancing the impact of all lightning-based techniques with devastating precision.

suggestion.rationale: Original description kept with targeted fixes: em dash replaced. Keeps the original battle line; removes the claimed speed boost and the 'piercing' wording, since the jutsu only raises lightning damage.

data.description: The user clasps their hands in prayer and calls down a divine bolt of lightning on the target. The holy glare leaves them shaken, dulling the force of their attacks for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves a multitude of hand signs, then clasps their hands in a praying motion. Their body is cloaked in lightning that almost seems divine. In a swift motion, lightning arcs toward %target, delivering a devastating blow.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; fixes the garbled 'sends in their hands clasped' and 'giving a devastating blow', and removes a trailing space. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user bends the target's mind until the ground seems to swallow them, the illusion striking at their senses. Panic grips them as they sink, weakening their attacks for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user bends the mind of %target and creates an illusion of them sinking into quicksand. The feeling is real as their body sinks into the sand, and they can feel it getting stuck under the pressure as they fall into a state of panic.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; fixes the run-on second sentence. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user sinks phantom fangs into the target, and the illusion of rotting flesh spreads across their skin. The rot feeds the user, letting them heal from a share of the damage they deal for a short time.

suggestion.rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user looses a jagged bolt of lightning from their palm into the target. The shock seizes their muscles and stuns them, costing them precious time.

suggestion.rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user charges their fist with lightning and releases a crackling shockwave on impact. The surge rattles through the target and stuns them.
data.battleDescription: This technique charges %user’s fists with electrical chakra to deliver a crushing blow. Upon impact, the strike releases a violent surge of electricity that deals damage and stuns %target, leaving them momentarily unable to act.

suggestion.rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user slams their hands to the earth and a ring of jagged stone pillars bursts up around the target. The pillars strike hard and may close in tight, leaving them unable to move for a short while.

suggestion.rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user packs compacted earth into hard stone shuriken and hurls them at the target. Each one lands with the dull weight of rock, battering them with earth.

suggestion.rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user skims chakra-weighted stones low across the ground so they bounce into the target in quick succession. The battering leaves them off balance, so the blows that follow land harder for a short while.

suggestion.rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: Harnessing the primal energy of the earth’s tectonic plates, the user channels a massive surge of chakra into their own body, turning every earth-based attack into a destructive force of nature.

suggestion.rationale: Original description kept with targeted fixes: it reshaped no terrain and deals no damage itself: it raises the user's Earth damage (+20%, 2 rounds); full stop added. Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged.

data.description: The user coils water around their arm and drives it into the target like a falling tide. The spray settles over their own body, softening the blows they take for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user surges forward, water spiraling tightly around their arm like a coiled serpent. As they drive their fist into %target, the crashing blow sends a shockwave rippling outward like a tidal surge erupting from their knuckles. The impact drenches the battlefield in pressurized chakra-infused water, fortifying %user’s body with a durable aquatic guard.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes the em dash and swaps 'shield' for 'guard', since the effect is damage reduction, not a shield. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: Summoning the might of the endless sea, the user commands the tides to swell their power, amplifying the force of every water-based assault with sovereign wrath.

suggestion.rationale: Original description kept with targeted fixes: em dash replaced. Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged.

data.description: The user compresses water into razor-edged shuriken and sends them spinning at the target. Each one strikes with the force of a breaking wave.

suggestion.rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user conjures a beast of churning water that surges forward and slams into the target. A vortex lingers around the user, turning part of the damage they take into health for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a massive beast made entirely of churning water, which surges forward to slam into %target. As it crashes home, a swirling vortex lingers around %user, turning a portion of incoming damage into health. This technique balances offense with a defensive advantage.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; uses %user and %target and describes the absorb as turning damage into health. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user wraps their weapon in a swirling vortex of wind chakra, honing its edge to a howling sharpness. They bring it down on the target with the force of a raging storm.

suggestion.rationale: Original battle line is accurate and clean, kept unchanged. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user draws the surrounding air into a tight vacuum around their body, compressing their chakra. For a short time their attacks strike harder and the pressure blunts incoming blows.
data.battleDescription: %user draws in surrounding air with a deep inhalation, forming an intense vacuum around their body. As the pressure equalizes, their chakra surges violently, amplifying the force and sharpness of every technique they unleash. The surrounding atmosphere distorts slightly, blunting incoming blows and signaling the enhanced potential of their next strike.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; the damage boost applies to all damage, not only wind, and the damage-taken reduction is now hinted. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user lets a light breeze carry their weapon into a swift, cutting strike. The wind lingers around the target and turns against them, so their own attacks rebound on them for a short time.
data.battleDescription: As %user channels wind chakra into their weapon, a light breeze envelops the blade. %user strikes with swift grace, the edge flashing toward %target faster than the eye can follow. As it connects, the breeze clings to %target and twists against them. Each blow they throw is caught by the contrary wind and hurled back upon them.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the opening and the four-sentence shape; the user gets no speed buff, so the lines now show the strike on %target and the wind turning their own blows back on them (recoil). Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user calls up a ghostly mist that strikes the target and seeps into their body. Over the next few rounds it bleeds away their health, chakra and stamina.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a seal, summoning a ghostly mist that seeps into %target’s body. Wisps of blue and red energy, chakra and stamina along with their very life, are ripped from them, spiraling away into the mist. %target’s limbs grow heavy, their strength fading as exhaustion takes hold. If they don’t break free, they’ll collapse under the relentless drain.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes the em dashes, adds health to the drained pools and drops the claim that the energy flows to the user. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user binds the target in chains of sealing script that lock their chakra against any new enhancement. The same seals ward the user, shielding them from debuffs for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves intricate seals in the air, summoning glowing ethereal chains that surge toward %target, coiling tightly to disrupt their chakra flow, suppressing any attempts to invoke new enhancements while the last links settle over %user as a ward against debuffs.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; it does not strip existing buffs (it blocks new ones), and the user's debuff ward is now mentioned. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user lays a festering blight on the target at close quarters, rotting at their body. The corruption can stop them from healing at all for several rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a malevolent elemental blight of fire, water, wind, earth, and lightning that engulfs %target, scorching their vitality and corrupting their recovery, leaving them unable to mend against %user’s assault.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes 'freezing chakra flow' and 'weakened and defenseless', which the jutsu does not do, leaving damage and heal prevention. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user calls down a storm that crashes over an area as a wave of lightning-charged water. The charge clings to every enemy it strikes, so their own attacks jolt back into them for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user raises their hands, summoning a massive storm as dark clouds gather and electricity crackles through the air, unleashing a torrential wave of electrified water that crashes toward %target with violent force, striking with bolts of lightning and dealing devastating damage while leaving the battlefield drenched and charged with residual energy that clings to whoever it struck, turning their own attacks back upon them.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; it has no heal prevention, so the lingering charge now describes the recoil on everything struck. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user wraps a pebble in water chakra and fires it on a surge of lightning at blinding speed. The charge left behind makes the target far more vulnerable to storm attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user coats a small pebble in water chakra, then using lightning, they supercharge it sending it flying toward %target before they can even react, inflicting massive injury with what seems like just a flick of a finger.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; adds the missing 'a'. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: Crippling Blade is a Forbidden S-Rank Bukijutsu that enhances the user's weapon with a dark, ominous aura, sapping the strength of their foe and dulling their strongest abilities for several rounds.
data.battleDescription: With a swift, calculated strike, %user's weapon is engulfed in a menacing, dark aura, crackling with malevolent energy. As the blade connects, the aura surges into %target's body, creeping through their veins like icy tendrils, sapping their strength and agility. %target's movements slow, each step becoming a laborious effort as the oppressive force of the curse weighs them down. The once nimble and powerful fighter now struggles against the debilitating effects of the jutsu, their greatest strengths drained and diminished.

suggestion.rationale: Original description kept with targeted fixes: wrong name 'Crippling Strike' fixed; the debuff lowers the target's highest stats, not Taijutsu (3 rounds). Keeps the original battle line; removes the wrong name 'Crippling Strike' and the Taijutsu-only claim, since the debuff hits the target's highest stat.

data.description: A lost oath that splits the sky with dust and yin-yang chakra and crashes down on the target, threatening to seal their elements. Its chains then bind the user, armoring them while every technique costs more for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user draws their weapon across the air without touching %target. For a heartbeat, nothing happens. Then the sky splits along the blade's path, and a silent dust-white wound opens above %target. The rupture crashes down, carving through defenses and sealing forbidden elements in its wake. As the oath closes, chains of chakra lash back around %user's arms, hardening them against harm while making every movement cost far more than it should.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; adds the user's damage reduction and replaces 'cost twice', which overstates the cost increase. Description from round 1, in American spelling.

data.description: The user presses their palms to the ground and draws vines and blossoms up to wrap around them. For several rounds the living growth turns part of every blow they take into health.
data.battleDescription: %user kneels and places their palms on the ground, channeling energy into the earth. Vines and blossoms emerge, wrapping gently around %user. The vibrant greenery pulses with life, ready to drink in incoming blows and knit them into health. The sweet scent of blooming flowers steadies %user’s resolve as the living growth stands guard.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line; removes %target on a self jutsu, describes the absorb (damage into health) instead of a direct heal, and drops the claimed strength buff. Description from round 1, unchanged.

data.description: The user wraps the target in coiling shadows that smother their strength and strip away their guard. For a short time the target hits more weakly and takes heavier damage from every blow.
data.battleDescription: %user performs a series of intricate hand seals, and the shadows around them coil and rise like a sentient tide. The darkness lunges across the field and wraps around %target, hardening into a suffocating shroud. Every strike %target throws dissipates weakly into the veil, as if swallowed by an abyss, while the shadows gnaw through their guard. The eerie shroud flickers and tightens, leaving %target exposed to every blow that follows.

suggestion.rationale: Original texts described a protective barrier, but the jutsu weakens the target's damage and raises the damage they take. Battle line keeps the original four-sentence shadow-tide imagery, now aimed at %target; description reuses the accurate round 1 text.

data.description: The user calls up the fiery essence of a dragon and looses twin fangs of flame that tear straight through the target's guard. The wounds keep smoldering for several rounds, so every hit the target takes afterwards burns deeper.
data.battleDescription: %user performs swift hand seals, summoning the fiery essence of a dragon. Twin fangs of flame erupt from their palms, spiraling with intense heat. With a ferocious roar, the fiery fangs lunge toward %target, searing through defenses and engulfing them in a blaze of dragon-shaped fury. Residual embers cling to %target long after the strike, making every blow that follows burn deeper.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original rich battle line; its closing sentence now shows the lingering afterburn instead of generic embers. Stub description replaced with a fuller one covering the guard-piercing hit and the afterburn.

data.description: The user calls down luminous drops of celestial dew that mend their wounds over the next round. The dew then settles into a shimmering shield that soaks up incoming damage for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user clasps their hands, invoking a soft, luminous chant. From above, ethereal droplets of dew descend, shimmering with celestial light. The dew gathers upon %user, mending wounds and revitalizing their spirit. As the healing touch takes effect, the droplets settle into a shimmering veil of light around %user, shielding them against further harm.

suggestion.rationale: The jutsu targets only the user, but the original healed allies and never mentioned the shield. Battle line keeps the original four sentences and chant imagery, drops the allies and closes on the shield.

data.description: Stolen from Subaku Castle, this technique lets the user call forth the demon palace, whose gates rise in a spiral across the battlefield. The palace fuels the user's attacks for a short time and saps the strength of every enemy caught within its walls for several rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user presses their hand to the ground, and a chakra formula spreads from their palm to the corners of the battlefield. Large demon gates rise out of the earth in a spiral, empowering their master and weighing on anything hostile caught within their walls.

suggestion.rationale: Description keeps the Subaku Castle lore but now states the actual effects (user hits harder, enemies in the area deal less damage) instead of 'offense and defense'. Battle line keeps the original image, removes %target from a ground jutsu and fixes grammar.

data.description:
The user spins into a cleaving whirlwind of razor-edged chakra that tears through everything in the area, friend or foe. For a short while those caught take heavier damage, and every later hit burns deeper.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user spins swiftly, their weapon or bare hands trailing razor-edged chakra. The air around them twists into a slicing vortex that rips across the battlefield. %target and everything caught in the tempest are battered by the cutting currents, friend and foe alike, and left raw to every blow that follows. The relentless storm fades with a final powerful slash, its wounds still burning hot beneath every new hit.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original whirlwind battle line at full length but drops the enemy-presence wording and the fire/wind element, adding the vulnerability and afterburn. Description notes that it hits allies too; the training warning is kept.

data.description: A forbidden jutsu that releases the shadows of the underworld on the target, piercing them with black lightning and leaving them open to heavier damage. For a short while the user feeds on the blows they land, though the darkness leaves them burning under every hit.
data.battleDescription: %user forces chakra through their body until it pours out into their shadow. The chakra mixes with their shadow, which grows and absorbs every bit of shadow in the vicinity. As the shadow spreads around %target it also expands, covering the surrounding area in complete darkness. The moment the jutsu hits, it locks %target in a dome of darkness where black razor spikes crackling with lightning jut from the ground and retract, stabbing %target and leaving them exposed to every blow to come. The darkness seeps back into %user, feeding on the blows they land while leaving them burning under every hit they take.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original premium battle line nearly word for word, fixing its grammar and missing full stop and adding the lightning, the target's vulnerability, the user's lifesteal and self-burn. Description keeps its opening and adds the effects.

data.description: A forbidden jutsu that burns the user's own lifeforce to power a high-flying dragon of fire that crashes down on the target, leaving wounds that keep burning. For a short time the user's attacks hit harder, though their scorched body takes extra damage from every hit.
data.battleDescription: %user uses a single hand to perform a series of simple hand seals before pressing the same hand on their blade. The blade shimmers briefly as %user jumps into the air, and the chakra flowing around the weapon bursts into flame and forms a dragon shape around %user, its maw centered on the tip. With breathtaking speed, %user plummets toward %target, smashing the blade into them with devastating power and destroying everything in the impact zone. The dragon's fire lingers in %target's wounds, while the lifeforce it burned leaves %user striking harder but scorched beneath every hit.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original dragon-dive battle line, fixing its run-on sentence and swapping the %weapon placeholder for 'blade' since no weapon is required. Adds the fire element, the lingering wound, and the user's damage buff and self-burn to both texts.

data.description: The user opens seven of the eight inner gates and releases a devastating tiger-shaped gale at the target, staggering them. The surge makes the user's attacks hit harder for a short time but leaves their body burning under every hit.
data.battleDescription: Waves of green and blue energy flow from %user's body as %user opens the first seven Inner Gates. Each Gate adds terrible force to their strikes, engulfing %user with an all-repelling aura of pure power. %user goes into the Tiger stance before striking the air in front of them with an explosion of power. The violent punch sends a massive tiger-shaped shockwave of wind crashing into %target, staggering them where they stand. The strain of the open Gates sears through %user's body, leaving them vulnerable to every blow even as their strikes grow heavier.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original Inner Gates battle line, fixing its typos and spacing and replacing the strength/speed claim with the real damage buff. Adds the stun and the user's self-burn to both texts.

data.description: A forbidden jutsu that brings the target's departed loved ones to the battlefield, crushing them in a cold mist and sealing their bloodline. The user's attacks hit harder for a short time, though every hit they take then burns deeper.
data.battleDescription: %user forms hand seals while smoke rises from their body. The smoke rapidly expands into a cold, damp cloud, engulfing %user and hiding them from sight. %target feels a cold chill run down their back as the area around them turns gray and all color drains from their vision. The mist materializes into spirit-like apparitions resembling deceased family members. They float around %target, softly wailing in agony as they close in, their cold grip crushing the breath from %target and smothering their bloodline while the borrowed grief sharpens %user's strikes and leaves them raw to every blow.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original spirit apparition battle line, in American spelling, and adds the damage, bloodline seal and the user's buff and self-burn. Description no longer addresses the reader and now lists the effects.

data.battleDescription: %user slams their hand to the ground, channeling earth chakra outward in all directions. Thick stone walls erupt across the field in rapid formation: dense, layered, and reinforced with chakra. These barriers deflect incoming strikes and dull the force of enemy attacks. While active, %user's body is further reinforced by lingering stone chakra, allowing them to absorb more punishment than usual.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line, which already covered the wall and damage reduction; only fixes the em dash, apostrophe, missing full stop and the wall's placement. Description unchanged.

data.description: A potent chakra buff that surges through every offensive path, making all of the user's attacks hit far harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user channels a surge of chakra beyond their natural limit, their aura expanding in a volatile ripple of power. This overflowing chakra wraps around them in thick, radiant waves, barely restrained. Chakra Overflow heightens every offensive path: physical strikes land harder, ninjutsu hits with greater force, and even genjutsu becomes more potent. The surge floods through %user's body and mind, doubling down on that force for the intensity of high-stakes combat. It is the edge between control and chaos, a moment where %user becomes a living conduit of power.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original five-sentence battle line, removing em dashes and the claim that core stats rise; both effects are damage buffs, now told as the surge doubling the force. Description drops the stat claim.

data.description: A high-speed weapon slash that deals massive damage to the target and briefly blocks every attempt to cleanse their ailments.
data.battleDescription: %user grips their weapon with both hands and crouches low before vanishing in a flash of speed. A single arc slices through the air past %target, and for a heartbeat, nothing happens. Then a diagonal wound bursts open across their body, blood spraying as if the strike had been delayed in time. But the real sting comes after: the wound lingers in %target's chakra and refuses every attempt to cleanse it, as if their body is punishing them for moving too soon.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original delayed-wound battle line; its last sentence claimed backlash on the target's attacks, which the jutsu does not do, and now describes the cleanse block. Description grammar fixed.

data.description:
A cursed enhancement that boosts the user's damage and restores health with every strike.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user draws in a slow breath as a shadow-like chakra coils around their arms and chest, pulsing with violent rhythm. Their strikes begin to land harder, the weight of each hit intensified by dark energy. As they attack, part of the damage inflicted siphons back into their body, restoring vitality through every blow.

suggestion.rationale: Original text was accurate; only a curly apostrophe, an em dash and a trailing space are fixed; the battle line is otherwise word for word.

data.description: The user drops into a low, still stance before detonating into eight rapid strikes in perfect rhythm, each landing with surgical precision. The relentless barrage shatters the target's guard and seals them off from any buffs for a moment.
data.battleDescription: %user's stance drops low, tense and almost still, then detonates. With masterful precision and tempestuous speed, they unleash eight rapid, deliberate strikes in perfect rhythm. Each blow strikes with surgical accuracy, shattering %target's guard and sending their balance crumbling under the relentless cadence, their body sealed off from any empowering chakra.

suggestion.rationale: Description was bland; now shows the eight-strike barrage and the buff block. Battle line keeps the original three sentences, fixing the em dash and apostrophes and dropping the knockback the jutsu does not have.

data.battleDescription: %user channels the wrath of the deep as water chakra surges down their spine and coils around their limbs like serpents from the abyss. With a chilling calm, they square up to %target and drive their fist forward, unleashing a crushing blow that echoes with the pressure of the ocean floor. The strike erupts in a spiral of black-blue water, tearing through defenses and drawing life essence back into %user like a drowning tide claiming its own. Each hit binds them deeper to the flow of %target's chakra, feeding life back into their body as they press on like the relentless sea.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original four-sentence battle line, fixing em dashes and an apostrophe, softening an implied movement and making the lifesteal read as life rather than strength. Description unchanged.

data.description: Creates a barrier of chakra that takes the shape of a lotus around the target, blocking all of their summoning. The glowing petals weigh on them as well, so their attacks deal less damage for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their palm to the ground, releasing a bloom of glowing lotus-shaped seals that spread outward in a perfect circle. The lotus petals rise upward, forming a radiant, semi-transparent barrier of light around %target, sealing away their summons and weighing down every strike they throw.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original lotus battle line and adds the summon block and the target's damage reduction it left out. Description grammar fixed and the damage reduction added.

data.description: Forms hardened water around the fists for devastating punches. Afterwards the water flows back over the user, strengthening their healing for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user's fists, surrounded by swirling, hardened water, unleash a barrage of punches at %target, each strike hitting with the force of crashing waves, before the water flows back over %user and strengthens their healing.

suggestion.rationale: Original claimed the punches disrupt the target's chakra and leave them vulnerable, which the jutsu does not do, and omitted the healing boost. Both texts keep their wording and now end on the user's stronger healing.

data.description: Envelops the user in flames to dash across the field with explosive speed and erupt in fire where they land, scorching every enemy caught in the blast. The blaze lingers around the user, making their attacks hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user focuses their chakra, igniting flames that swirl around their body. With a sudden burst of energy, they propel themselves forward at blinding speed, leaving a trail of fire in their wake. The intense heat generated by their movement scorches the ground and air, making their path difficult to follow. As %user moves, the flames around them roar and grow, turning their rapid dashes into fiery streaks that sear anything they touch. The final strike comes when %user reaches their destination, the flames concentrating into a devastating kick or punch that sends a wave of fire bursting across the surrounding ground. The battlefield is left smoldering, with %user standing amidst the remnants of their fiery dash, the flames still roaring around their fists.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original six-sentence battle line but removes the assumed opponent from an empty-ground area jutsu and hints the user's damage buff. Description adds the fire burst on landing and the buff.

data.description: Blazing coils of fire wrap around the target and scorch them. The seared skin leaves them vulnerable, so they take more damage for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user summons blazing coils of fire that wrap around %target, searing their skin and leaving them vulnerable to further damage.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original battle line with a grammar fix. Description's verb agreement and missing full stop fixed and the damage-taken effect added.

data.description: The user channels earth chakra to deliver a powerful Earthquake Slam, causing the ground to shake upon impact with the target. The force of the quake surges into the user's own strikes, making them hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user's decisive slam sends shockwaves through the ground beneath %target, and the earth's power answers %user, loading their next strikes with greater force.

suggestion.rationale: Original claimed it staggers nearby enemies; it is a single-target hit with no stun. Both texts keep their opening and now show the user's damage buff as power flowing into their strikes.

data.description: Eight Fist Style: Earthen Grasp is a taijutsu technique that focuses on immobilizing the opponent. Its earth-charged blows call stone hands from the ground that can root the target in place for a moment.
data.battleDescription: %user channels Earth Release chakra into their fists, delivering a barrage of strikes that causes the ground to erupt. Earthen hands emerge and seize %target's legs. %user finishes with a crushing kick, sending %target to the ground, where the earthen hands may keep them from moving.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original three-sentence battle line; the move block stays a real chance at max level, so 'immobilizing' and 'unable to move' are softened to chance wording. Description keeps its sentence and adds the hit and root chance.

data.description: Ignites the user's fist for a strike that releases a burst of fire, scorching the target and the ground around them.
data.battleDescription: With a focused burst of chakra, %user ignites their fist in roaring flames. The strike releases a fiery shockwave that scorches %target and the ground around them.

suggestion.rationale: Original description addressed the reader and assumed nearby enemies. Both texts keep their wording and now describe the blast reaching the ground around the target.

data.description: Unlocks the user's chakra flow, making all of their attacks hit harder while the surging energy dulls the damage they take for a short time.
data.battleDescription: A deep roar echoes from within as %user tears open the first chakra gate. Their aura erupts in a violent surge of energy, rippling through the air like a heatwave. Veins glow beneath their skin as raw chakra floods their network, amplifying every movement and sharpening their control. The ground beneath them fractures under the pressure, and the battlefield trembles as their techniques flare with newfound ferocity, faster, heavier, and more destructive than before, while the surging aura dulls every blow that reaches them.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original four-sentence battle line; the damage buff applies to all attacks, not only ninjutsu, and the missing damage reduction is added. Description capitalized and corrected the same way.

data.description: A burning taijutsu attack that damages the enemy and weakens their stats for a short time.

suggestion.rationale: The original battle line was already correct in American spelling and is kept unchanged. Description only gains its missing full stop and a duration.

data.description: A taijutsu technique that hardens the user's body to blunt incoming blows and boost their striking power for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user tightens their stance, chakra flowing into their limbs until the muscle fibers tense like steel cables. A faint aura pulses around their fists, dense, controlled, and brimming with suppressed force. Harden Fist enhances the body at its core, toughening it against incoming blows while reinforcing every strike with hardened impact. The result is a sharper, more brutal form of taijutsu, each blow landing with enhanced precision and punishing force. It is not just about hitting harder; it is about becoming a weapon in motion.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original five-sentence battle line, fixing em dashes and the truncated last word, and replaces the Strength/Speed stat claim with the actual damage reduction. Description corrected the same way.

data.description: The user spins into a wind-charged kick that bursts into a gale around the target, battering everything caught in the blast. The momentum carries through the user's body, raising their strength, speed, taijutsu and bukijutsu for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user channels wind chakra into their leg, executing a spinning kick that generates a powerful gust, striking %target with force as the gale tears across the surrounding ground.

suggestion.rationale: Original battle line kept; drops the knockback it does not have and adds the area gust without assuming anyone is there. Description covers the blast and the self stat buff.

data.description: The user conjures a freezing polar vortex that engulfs the target and the ground around them. The bitter cold numbs whoever it catches, so their attacks deal less damage for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a raging vortex of ice, engulfing %target in relentless, churning frost.

suggestion.rationale: Original battle line kept but it named water on an Ice jutsu. Description now describes the vortex area rather than enemies at the target's side, and adds the damage-dealt reduction.

data.description: The user raises a spinning column of fire around the target. The blaze leaves them smoldering, so each blow they take over the next few rounds burns deeper.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a blazing cyclone, engulfing %target in flames that leave them smoldering against the blows to come.

suggestion.rationale: Original battle line claimed a strength debuff it does not have; now hints the afterburn. Description from round one in American spelling.

data.description: A fiery aura that shields the user against incoming blows. Through methods few understand, it also turns part of the damage they take into renewed energy.
data.battleDescription: %user ignites their inner fire, reducing the force of incoming blows and using the energy to replenish and reinforce themselves.

suggestion.rationale: Absorb now reads as turning damage into health, per the director, with no chakra or stamina named. Removed the unbacked power boost and the trailing spaces. Its absorb restores energy rather than health, so the text says energy.

data.description: The user channels lightning chakra into their limbs to deliver a swift series of electrifying taijutsu strikes.

suggestion.rationale: The live battle line already uses %target, so it is kept unchanged. Only the description's 'your' is fixed.

data.description: The user flashes to a new position in a burst of lightning, unleashing strikes that pierce any guard across the area around their landing point. The shocks linger, hurting anyone struck again over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user surrounds themselves with lightning chakra, flashing to a new position at blinding speed and delivering rapid, precise strikes from all angles that tear through any guard.

suggestion.rationale: Drops the rejected 'on a crack of lightning' wording and returns to the original line, fixing %target on an empty-ground jutsu. Description now covers the move, piercing strikes and lingering wound.

data.description: Lightning Release: Thunder Edge is a versatile jutsu that allows the user to infuse their weapon with lightning chakra and drive it into the ground. The charge erupts around the target in a surge of electrical energy that stuns anything caught in it over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a surge of electrical chakra through their blade and strikes the ground. The current races out from the blade, crackling across the surrounding ground and wrapping itself around %target.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original two-part text; area wording describes the surge across the ground instead of enemies near the target. Stun kept as 'can' because it stays below certain at the cap.

data.description: Envelops the user's weapon in lightning, strengthening their Lightning attacks and leaving the target vulnerable to all further attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user surrounds their weapon with crackling lightning, empowering their Lightning techniques before marking %target with a jolt of electricity that leaves them vulnerable to further attacks.

suggestion.rationale: Returns to the original text without the parlor-trick spark. Fixes 'your' and the scope: the buff covers all Lightning damage and the target takes more damage from every source.

data.description: A mythical genjutsu in which the user channels the power of Medusa, their eyes turning a cold serpent yellow. For a short time every attack they make strikes harder, and the blows against them land softer.
data.battleDescription: %user closes their eyes and gathers chakra as the air grows still around them. When the lids lift, a cold serpent's stare looks out, and Medusa's power floods through %user, strengthening every strike and blunting the blows that come for them.

suggestion.rationale: The original battle line was broken. New line keeps its closed-eyes-then-gaze arc as a two-sentence premium line without pierce-like wording; both texts now state the damage boost and damage reduction.

data.description: The user smashes the earth so the ground quakes and shatters across the area around the target. The tremors break the footing of anything caught in them, leaving it open to more damage for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user smashes the earth, sending shockwaves rippling through the ground around %target and weakening their defenses against further attacks.

suggestion.rationale: Original battle line kept with the shockwave spreading through the ground instead of 'the enemies around them'. Description covers the area and the vulnerability.

data.description: Tempestual Fury is a wind-element Ninjutsu that summons a devastating storm of immense size and power. Its winds leave everything they batter raw, so the hits that follow strike harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a raging tempest, its ferocious winds slamming into %target and scouring the ground around them with relentless force.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original text, fixing the misnamed jutsu and the leading space. Area is described as scoured ground rather than enemies around the target; afterburn added.

data.description: Summons a barrage of lightning bolts at the target while surrounding the user with a current that wards off harmful effects for a short time.

suggestion.rationale: Original text kept; description fixes 'yourself' and states the debuff ward plainly with no 'very likely'.

data.description: Uses water-enhanced strikes to overwhelm the target, the surge spilling outward over the surrounding ground.
data.battleDescription: %user channels chakra into the water, amplifying their strength to unleash a series of powerful, wave-infused blows that batter %target, leaving them soaked as the surge spills across the surrounding ground.

suggestion.rationale: Original text kept; the area is the surge spreading over the ground, not enemies close by, and the unbacked disorientation is dropped.

data.battleDescription: %user channels water chakra through their limbs, shaping it into a sinuous, whip-like flow around their arm. With swift, coiling motion, they dart toward %target and unleash a fierce, fluid strike that lashes across flesh like a serpent breaking the surface. The impact disorients the enemy's defenses, soaking them in reactive chakra that lingers like venom, heightening the damage they suffer from subsequent attacks. The strike is silent, swift, and merciless, like the serpent it's named for.

suggestion.rationale: Restores the full original battle line, only replacing its em dashes. Description was already accurate.

data.description: The user wreathes the target in clinging flames that make every later hit burn deeper. The fire also feeds the user, letting their own attacks draw back life over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user sets %target smoldering in a ring of fire, the embers curling back to mend %user with each blow that follows.

suggestion.rationale: Original was broken (typos, no full stop, described lifesteal as absorbing the target's health). Round one text kept in American spelling.

data.description: The user wraps the target in a clinging haze of fire chakra that does no harm by itself. For a short time every blow they take burns deeper, and fire techniques strike them harder still.
data.battleDescription: %user breathes a shimmering wave of heat over %target, leaving them smoldering and primed for the flames to come.

suggestion.rationale: The original implied direct damage the jutsu does not deal. Round one text kept, with American spelling.

data.description: Channeling searing flames, the user ignites their body and strikes, engulfing their foe in fire while fueling their own fire techniques with unrelenting heat.
data.battleDescription: A roar of flame erupts as %user's body ignites with blazing energy, surging forward in a torrent of fire. The onslaught engulfs %target, searing all it touches while each ember clings to %user, feeding their power and amplifying the fury behind every flame that follows.

suggestion.rationale: Keeps the original premium text in full; removes the em dash and narrows the damage boost to fire, matching the Fire-only effect.

data.description: A spiraling blaze of fire chakra that scorches the area around the target. Everything it engulfs is left smoldering, so the hits that follow burn deeper.
data.battleDescription: %user channels refined fire chakra into a spiraling blaze that engulfs %target. The scorching flames sweep the surrounding ground and leave everything they touch smoldering, so each hit that follows burns deeper.

suggestion.rationale: Original text kept in American spelling; the afterburn is described as later hits burning deeper rather than a lingering burn, and the area is shown without assuming foes.

data.description: A water-based strike that crushes the enemy, then coils around the user to turn part of the damage they take into health.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a burst of high-pressure water that lashes out toward %target, striking with force before swirling around their own body. The lingering vortex hardens like fluid armor, drinking in a portion of the damage from the attacks that follow and turning it into health.

suggestion.rationale: Original text kept (already American). Only the absorb wording changes so it reads as turning damage into health.

data.description: The people of Hyorin have cohabitated with the Ancient Penguins and have earned the favor of Lord Pengu, who answers the user's call and fights at their side for several rounds.

suggestion.rationale: Original kept; Glacier renamed Hyorin, full stop added and the summon's duration noted. Battle line unchanged.

data.description: A high-speed wind slash that carves through the area around the target, dealing heavy damage and draining health, chakra and stamina over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user blurs forward in a burst of wind, slashing through %target with razor-sharp wind chakra. The cutting force is so intense it leaves a trail of cleaved air behind, carving across the surrounding ground and draining the strength of all it cuts.

suggestion.rationale: Original text kept; area is the cleaved ground rather than people around the target, and the unbacked teleport is dropped. Description adds the full drain and a full stop.

data.description: This technique has been passed down by several ninja of old times. By achieving control of the wind nature, the user subjugates the winds around their fists and legs, and every blow leaves a miniature cyclone at the point of impact that keeps cutting at the target over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user enters a wind-infused trance and unleashes a blur of strikes on %target. Each rapid punch and kick leaves a miniature cyclone spinning at the point of impact, shredding at %target long after the blow lands.

suggestion.rationale: Original text kept; cyclones now spin at the point of impact and keep dealing damage, per the director. Removes the unbacked immobilize and 'his'.

data.battleDescription: %user reinforces their arm with dense earth chakra before launching a crushing punch into %target's core. The impact echoes like stone slamming into steel, rocking the opponent and disrupting their ability to channel power. The force of the strike not only causes direct physical damage but saps their offensive momentum, reducing the strength of their follow-up attacks.

suggestion.rationale: Restores the full original battle line; only 'staggering' changes, since the jutsu has no stun. Description was already accurate.

data.description: This technique focuses on utilizing fire elemental chakra on the leg to erupt in fire as it makes contact with the opponent. The flames keep burning afterward, draining their health over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user channels fire chakra into their leg, delivering a swift roundhouse kick to %target. The impact erupts in a burst of flames, scorching %target and leaving them burning.

suggestion.rationale: Original text kept in American spelling; adds the health drain and drops the stagger, which the jutsu does not have.

data.battleDescription: %user crushes a roaring tornado into a dense sphere of air and unleashes it on %target, the blast ripping straight through their defenses.

suggestion.rationale: American spelling only: defences. No other change to the text applied in push/196.

data.description: The user wraps their fist in a spiraling vortex of lightning and drives it into the target. The charge clings to them, so every hit that follows burns deeper for a short time.

suggestion.rationale: American spelling only: spiralling. No other change to the text applied in push/196.

data.battleDescription: %user summons spiked vines that wrap around %target, puncturing them and leaving their defenses exposed.

suggestion.rationale: American spelling only: defences. No other change to the text applied in push/196.

data.battleDescription: %user floods their weapon with storm chakra and rains a rapid series of strikes on %target, the leftover current gathering around them like armor.

suggestion.rationale: American spelling only: armour. No other change to the text applied in push/196.

data.description: The user charges their fists with lightning and lands a strike that bursts with a thunderous boom. The crackling energy surges through their body, sharpening their offense and defense for a short time.

suggestion.rationale: American spelling only: defence, offence. No other change to the text applied in push/196.

data.description: The user dances within circling currents of wind that cushion incoming blows. The flowing air sharpens their movements, raising their offense and defense for a short time.

suggestion.rationale: American spelling only: defence, offence. No other change to the text applied in push/196.

data.description: The user hurls seal-made pellets that burst into a cloud of acid around the target. The particles eat into their armor, leaving them more vulnerable to damage for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user flicks a handful of acid-filled pellets at %target, and as they burst the fine mist seeps through their defenses.

suggestion.rationale: American spelling only: armour, defences. No other change to the text applied in push/196.

data.battleDescription: %user slams a hand to the ground and a spiraling vortex of lightning tears up through the earth, crackling around every enemy inside.

suggestion.rationale: American spelling only: spiralling. No other change to the text applied in push/196.

data.battleDescription: %user draws chakra inward until it settles over their body like armor, steeling them to endure and to strike back harder.

suggestion.rationale: American spelling only: armour. No other change to the text applied in push/196.

data.description: The user releases a spiraling vortex of bladed wind that shreds the target and everything around them. Every enemy caught in the storm is left raw, so the blows that follow hurt more for a short time.

suggestion.rationale: American spelling only: spiralling. No other change to the text applied in push/196.

data.battleDescription: %user swings through a spiraling riptide that drags across the battlefield, the dark water flowing back to feed %user.

suggestion.rationale: American spelling only: spiralling. No other change to the text applied in push/196.

data.description: The user whips up a spiraling gale of cutting winds that tears through every enemy in its path. The surge of speed carries on through the user, making their attacks hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a spiraling storm of razor winds across the field, the gale feeding back into their own strength.

suggestion.rationale: American spelling only: spiralling. No other change to the text applied in push/196.
